beats.label: S1 · Return to the Quarter
beats.text: Klaus returns to New Orleans and finds his sired protégé Marcel ruling the Quarter, the Mikaelson family home lost to him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the central Klaus-vs-Marcel dynamic and the family's stake in the city.

beats.label: S1 · The impossible child
beats.text: Werewolf Hayley is pregnant with Klaus's impossible child; witches magically link her life to Sophie's to force Klaus into moving against Marcel.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Hope is the axis of every future season; the linking spell forces Klaus into the city's politics.

beats.label: S1 · Davina, hidden weapon
beats.text: Klaus learns Marcel's secret weapon is Davina, a teen witch hidden from her coven to prevent a Harvest ritual that would sacrifice her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the Harvest, Davina's power, and the pipeline that will resurrect Esther's line.

beats.label: S1 · Rebekah's old betrayal
beats.text: Rebekah's old betrayal surfaces — a century ago she summoned Mikael to kill Klaus. Klaus banishes her from New Orleans.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes Rebekah from the city and hands her the role of Hope's protector-in-exile.

beats.label: S1 · Harvest and the witch war
beats.text: Witches force the Harvest and Celeste, possessing Sabine, resurrects dead witches; a war between witches, wolves, and Klaus's family erupts.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Completes the ritual mechanism that lets Esther and her sons return next season.

beats.label: S1 · Hope is born, Hayley turns
beats.text: Hayley dies giving birth to Hope with the baby's blood in her — she wakes a hybrid. Klaus fakes Hope's death and hides her away with Rebekah.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the family's core secret and Hayley's new state going forward.

beats.label: S1 · Esther walks again
beats.text: Davina secretly resurrects Mikael as her weapon. In the cemetery, Esther inhabits the fourth Harvest girl Cassie — a boy at her side calling her mother.
beats.whyLoadBearing: This is the entire launchpad into Season 2 — mother and brothers back, father available.

cliffhanger.text: Klaus, Elijah, and Hayley have publicly lost Hope to protect her — she is alive and hidden with Rebekah. Meanwhile Esther has taken over the fourth Harvest girl Cassie, a boy at her side calling her mother, and Davina has secretly brought Mikael back from the ashes.
questions: Can Klaus keep Hope's survival secret from a mother who created his kind?
What does Esther want with the sons she once daggered for a thousand years?
How long before Davina points Mikael and his white oak stake at Klaus?

characters.name: Klaus Mikaelson
characters.line: The Original hybrid, secret father to newborn Hope, back in New Orleans and still fighting Marcel for the Quarter.

characters.name: Elijah Mikaelson
characters.line: Klaus's older brother and the family's moral spine; quietly in love with Hayley and sworn to protect the child.

characters.name: Rebekah Mikaelson
characters.line: The youngest Original sister, banished by Klaus and now raising Hope in hiding.
characters.note: Off-screen with Hope at season's end.

characters.name: Hayley Marshall
characters.line: Hope's werewolf mother; died in childbirth with her baby's blood in her system and woke as a hybrid.

characters.name: Marcel Gerard
characters.line: Klaus's oldest sired vampire, weakened by the family's return but still a player in the Quarter.

characters.name: Davina Claire
characters.line: The powerful teen witch, no longer under Marcel or her coven, quietly hoarding Mikael.

characters.name: Hope Mikaelson
characters.line: The miracle baby the world believes died at birth; hidden with Rebekah.

characters.name: Camille O'Connell
characters.line: Psych student and bartender pulled into Mikaelson orbit, tied to Marcel and repeatedly compelled by Klaus.

characters.name: Esther
characters.line: The Mikaelson matriarch, resurrected inside Harvest girl Cassie's body, plotting against the children she made.

beats.label: S2 · Family in new bodies
beats.text: Esther returns in Cassie's body with sons Finn and Kol resurrected in new hosts, offering to remake her Original children as mortals in new bodies of their own.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the season's driver: Esther's offer, which forces every sibling to pick a side.

beats.label: S2 · Mikael dies, Freya arrives
beats.text: Klaus finally kills his father Mikael for good. Long-lost eldest sibling Freya Mikaelson reveals herself — held captive for centuries by Esther's witch sister Dahlia.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Retires Mikael as a threat and introduces Freya and Dahlia, the real season villains.

beats.label: S2 · Dahlia's debt
beats.text: Freya's captor Dahlia will now come for Hope, the Mikaelson firstborn owed to her by an ancient bargain Esther made a thousand years ago.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the stake — Hope's life — that drives the rest of the season.

beats.label: S2 · Hayley cursed, Hayley wed
beats.text: Esther curses Hayley and her pack — human only on the full moon. Hayley marries werewolf Jackson so hybrid power spreads through their unification ring rite.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Locks Hayley into the pack and ends any clean future with Elijah.

beats.label: S2 · Brothers fall
beats.text: Kol dies. Elijah takes out Finn at Hope's safe house. The family fractures over whether to trust Freya as Dahlia's deadline for Hope closes in.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Thins the family and forces the fragile Freya-alliance that carries the finale.

beats.label: S2 · Esther and Dahlia die
beats.text: Freya briefly sides with Dahlia, then reunites with her siblings. Freya kills Esther herself, and together they take down Dahlia, ending Esther's thousand-year war on her children.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Clears the original-family threat and clears the deck for new enemies next season.

beats.label: S2 · Rebekah's borrowed body
beats.text: Kol betrays Rebekah, placing her soul in a witch's body. Hope is finally home with Klaus and Hayley — but Hayley must live in the cursed pack, apart from Elijah.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The state everyone starts Season 3 in: a Rebekah in a stranger, a family reunited but not whole.

cliffhanger.text: Dahlia is dead, Esther is dead, and Hope is home. But Rebekah walks around in a witch's body, Hayley is chained to a cursed pack she can only leave on a full moon, and the Mikaelsons have destroyed the oldest enemies they had left.
questions: Can Klaus and Hayley co-parent Hope when Hayley is a wolf twenty-nine days a month?
What does Rebekah owe the witch whose body she now occupies?
With their oldest enemies gone, whose grudge is next in line for a family this old?

characters.name: Klaus Mikaelson
characters.line: Original hybrid, now father to Hope, who has killed his own father this season to protect her.

characters.name: Elijah Mikaelson
characters.line: The noble brother, in love with Hayley but separated from her by her marriage and curse.

characters.name: Rebekah Mikaelson
characters.line: Her soul currently housed in the witch Eva Sinclair's body while her original body waits.

characters.name: Freya Mikaelson
characters.line: Long-lost eldest Mikaelson sister and immensely powerful witch, newly folded into the family.

characters.name: Hayley Marshall
characters.line: Hybrid, alpha, now married to Jackson and cursed with her pack to wolf form outside the full moon.

characters.name: Hope Mikaelson
characters.line: Toddler daughter of Klaus and Hayley, finally living with her parents.

characters.name: Kol Mikaelson
characters.line: Brother, dead again; Davina is publicly determined to bring him back.

characters.name: Marcel Gerard
characters.line: Klaus's protégé, mostly allied with the Mikaelsons after standing beside them against Esther and Dahlia.

characters.name: Davina Claire
characters.line: Grieving Kol, distrusted by her coven, working every angle of dark magic to resurrect him.

characters.name: Vincent Griffith
characters.line: The witch whose body Finn stole all season; freed at last, now sober to what the Mikaelsons cost the city.

beats.label: S3 · The prophecy
beats.text: Freya sees a prophecy — the three Mikaelson siblings will fall one by friend, one by foe, and one by family.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The lens the family reads every choice through this season; drives Elijah's fatal decision at the end.

beats.label: S3 · Klaus's first vampires
beats.text: Klaus's oldest sired vampires arrive: charming Lucien, aristocrat Tristan, and Klaus's ancient lover Aurora, each carrying a thousand-year grudge.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the season's villains and the sireline machinery that will nearly wipe out the Originals.

beats.label: S3 · The Strix move
beats.text: Tristan's ancient vampire society the Strix moves against the Mikaelsons, plotting to break the sirelines with a weapon that could wipe them out.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Escalates the threat and sets up the sireline break that later isolates Klaus.

beats.label: S3 · Aurora's revenge
beats.text: Aurora turns Cami into a vampire out of spite for Klaus; Rebekah is hit with a maddening hex and daggers herself to spare the family.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes Rebekah from the board and starts the string of losses that will break Klaus.

beats.label: S3 · Davina and Cami die
beats.text: The ancestors compel Kol to kill Davina. Then Lucien bites and kills Cami. Klaus loses the two people who kept him human.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Explains Marcel's rupture from the family and Kol's grief that will drive the Ancestor-cutting later.

beats.label: S3 · Elijah kills Marcel
beats.text: Fearing Marcel is the 'family' of the prophecy, Elijah kills him. Marcel drinks Lucien's serum, resurrects as an enhanced Original the Mikaelsons cannot fight.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The exact wrong choice — creates the enemy who will end Klaus's rule of the city.

beats.label: S3 · Marcel takes the city
beats.text: Marcel defeats the family and daggers Klaus into the compound wall. Freya spell-sleeps the siblings; Hayley flees New Orleans with Hope and four coffins.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The state Season 4 opens in: Marcel king, Klaus captive, Hayley on the road.

cliffhanger.text: Marcel now rules New Orleans as an unkillable enhanced Original, with Klaus daggered and walled inside their old home. The rest of the Mikaelsons lie hexed or super-bitten in coffins, kept alive only by Freya's spell, while Hayley and toddler Hope drive them across the country hunting cures that may not exist.
questions: How long can Freya's coma-spell hold four siblings on the edge of dying?
Can Hayley find cures for a hex, a poison, and an enhanced-Original bite that has never had one?
Will Marcel ever forgive the family that raised him and then killed him?

characters.name: Klaus Mikaelson
characters.line: Daggered with the Papa Tunde blade and walled into the compound, conscious and in agony as the anchor for Freya's spell.

characters.name: Elijah Mikaelson
characters.line: Dying of Marcel's enhanced-Original bite and locked in a coma with his siblings by Freya's magic.

characters.name: Hayley Marshall
characters.line: Free of the pack curse, on the run with Hope and the four coffins, looking for cures no one has ever made.

characters.name: Hope Mikaelson
characters.line: Toddler, on the road with her mother, effectively without extended family.

characters.name: Marcel Gerard
characters.line: Enhanced Original after drinking Lucien's serum; sole ruler of New Orleans and estranged from the family that made him.

characters.name: Freya Mikaelson
characters.line: In a coffin, but keeping the whole family alive by force of will and a linked sleeping spell.

characters.name: Rebekah Mikaelson
characters.line: Cursed with a maddening hex; daggered inside her Original body to keep the hex at bay.

characters.name: Kol Mikaelson
characters.line: Resurrected by Davina then super-bitten; sleeping in the coffins beside Elijah.

characters.name: Vincent Griffith
characters.line: The city's sole witch regent, sober about the Mikaelsons and increasingly aligned with Marcel.

characters.name: Davina Claire
characters.line: Killed by Kol on the ancestors' compulsion; her soul is lost to the ancestors in the afterlife void, and her death is what makes Kol and Vincent open to cutting the ancestors off entirely.

beats.label: S4 · Five years, one king
beats.text: Five years pass. Marcel rules the Quarter alone. Hayley finally collects the werewolf venoms to cure Freya, who wakes and revives the sleeping siblings.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resets the board: Marcel entrenched, Hope grown, family walking back into a city that has moved on.

beats.label: S4 · The Hollow is loose
beats.text: An ancient spirit called the Hollow has been freed. Cutting the Ancestors' link opened the door it had been locked behind for a thousand years.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the season's threat and quietly ties Davina and Kol's Ancestor cut in Season 3 to the current disaster.

beats.label: S4 · The Hollow wants Hope
beats.text: The Hollow's cult sacrifices children across the Quarter and targets Hope; her Labonair werewolf bloodline is the anchor their resurrection ritual requires.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Hope on the ritual altar and hooks the family into the fight.

beats.label: S4 · Truces and reunions
beats.text: Klaus and Marcel form an uneasy truce against the cult. Hayley and Elijah fall back into each other while trying to keep their daughter alive.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Restarts the Elijah/Hayley romance and the Klaus/Marcel bond that both matter for the finale.

beats.label: S4 · Killing Inadu
beats.text: Hayley kills Inadu with a blade dipped in Hope's blood — but as she dies, the Hollow completes a spell that lets her spirit possess Hope.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The apparent win that isn't; explains why the family can't just walk away at the end.

beats.label: S4 · Split across four
beats.text: To bind it, the family splits the Hollow's magic across all four Mikaelson siblings. If any two ever come near each other again, the spirit will re-form.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The exile arrangement that defines every character's opening position in Season 5.

beats.label: S4 · The family scatters
beats.text: At Elijah's request, Marcel and Vincent erase his memories of the family before the siblings scatter to opposite continents. Hayley takes Hope to a school for the supernatural.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Places every returning character exactly where Season 5 finds them.

cliffhanger.text: The Hollow is contained only by geography — its magic is split across Klaus, Elijah, Rebekah, and Kol, and Hope must be kept away from all of them or the spirit will reassemble. Elijah has been stripped of his memory of the family entirely, and Hope is being raised as a Salvatore School student, separated from her father.
questions: What happens the first time a Mikaelson is pulled back to family they now can't touch?
Will Elijah ever recover the memories Marcel and Vincent stripped from him?
Can any spirit really be held forever by four vampires refusing to be in the same room?

characters.name: Klaus Mikaelson
characters.line: Free, sober about being a father, and forbidden from ever being near his siblings again.

characters.name: Elijah Mikaelson
characters.line: Memories of the Mikaelsons scrubbed; playing piano in a bar in France with no idea who he is.

characters.name: Rebekah Mikaelson
characters.line: Back in her own body, living with Marcel in New York — one of the Hollow's four vessels.

characters.name: Kol Mikaelson
characters.line: Reunited with a resurrected Davina; another of the four vessels.

characters.name: Freya Mikaelson
characters.line: Building a life with the werewolf Keelin; also carries a shard of the Hollow.

characters.name: Hayley Marshall
characters.line: Taking Hope to the Salvatore School so her daughter can grow up somewhere the family cannot reach her.

characters.name: Hope Mikaelson
characters.line: A powerful young witch-wolf-vampire hybrid, enrolled at a school for supernatural children.

characters.name: Marcel Gerard
characters.line: Ruler of the New Orleans vampires, reunites with Rebekah in New York, one of the two men who wiped Elijah's memory.

characters.name: Vincent Griffith
characters.line: The city's witch regent, the architect of Elijah's memory wipe and the seer of the family's peace.

characters.name: Davina Claire
characters.line: Resurrected by the Hollow and bound to her, unbound by Hope before the killing ritual; leaves New Orleans with Kol.

beats.label: S5 · Seven years apart
beats.text: Seven years pass. Hope is a teenage witch at the Salvatore School; the Mikaelson siblings remain scattered so the Hollow inside them cannot re-form.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the state everyone begins the final season in.

beats.label: S5 · Hope forces the reunion
beats.text: Hoping to force a family reunion, Hope turns her friend Henry into a hybrid. In the fallout, Hayley is abducted from New Orleans.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The inciting event that pulls Klaus back to the Quarter and starts the endgame.

beats.label: S5 · Elijah in France
beats.text: Elijah is living in France with a vampire named Antoinette, still remembering nothing of the Mikaelsons; he rejects Klaus when Klaus finds him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Places Elijah at the maximum distance from Klaus before pulling him back over the season.

beats.label: S5 · A very old grudge
beats.text: Antoinette's mother Greta and brother Roman are behind the kidnapping — vampires who blame Klaus for their father's murder generations ago.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the human villains and ties Elijah's love back into the season's central conflict.

beats.label: S5 · Hayley dies
beats.text: Hayley dies saving Hope from Greta. Hope's rage later incinerates Greta's fanatics in a church; a bystander is caught in the blast and dies, triggering her werewolf curse.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's grief engine — sets Hope on the path to activating the Hollow inside her.

beats.label: S5 · The Hollow eats Hope
beats.text: Elijah's memories return through a ritual. The Hollow inside Hope begins to kill her, and the family realises they must move its magic somewhere it can be ended.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the finale's central choice about who takes the Hollow next.

beats.label: S5 · The brothers die
beats.text: Klaus draws the Hollow into himself so Hope will live. He and Elijah then stake each other with white oak, ending both brothers — and the Hollow — for good.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The series' final beat; without it the ending is incoherent.

cliffhanger.text: Klaus and Elijah are dead by their own hands, staked with white oak to destroy the Hollow forever. Hope survives, orphaned but free of the spirit's magic, and the remaining Mikaelsons — Rebekah, Kol, Freya — walk into lives without their brothers for the first time in a thousand years.
questions: What kind of life is Hope inheriting as the last of her bloodline?
Will Rebekah take the promised vampire cure and finally live as a human beside Marcel?
How does a family built around Klaus continue without him at its centre?

characters.name: Klaus Mikaelson
characters.line: Dead by white oak, the Hollow destroyed with him.

characters.name: Elijah Mikaelson
characters.line: Memories restored in time to die at his brother's side, staking Klaus as Klaus staked him.

characters.name: Hope Mikaelson
characters.line: Orphaned teenage tribrid, a triggered werewolf, alive because her father took the Hollow into himself.

characters.name: Hayley Marshall
characters.line: Killed by Greta earlier in the season; the grief that shapes everyone's endgame choices.

characters.name: Rebekah Mikaelson
characters.line: Alive, promised the vampire cure at last, engaged to Marcel and free to live a mortal life.

characters.name: Marcel Gerard
characters.line: Alive, engaged to Rebekah, having led the New Orleans vampires out of the city for good.

characters.name: Freya Mikaelson
characters.line: Alive with Keelin, starting a family with Vincent's help.

characters.name: Kol Mikaelson
characters.line: Alive with Davina, unburdened of the Hollow at last.

characters.name: Antoinette
characters.line: The vampire Elijah loved in France; alive, unaware her family's revenge helped kill the man she was going to marry.
characters.note: Daughter of Auguste, sister to Greta and Roman.
